problem_statement: Return a copy of s where every occurrence of character old is replaced with character new. Characters not equal to old are left unchanged. s is any Python string; old and new are single character strings.
valid_input_domain: Return a copy of s where every occurrence of character old is replaced with character new. Characters not equal to old are left unchanged. s is any Python string; old and new are single character strings.
bug_explanation: The faulty solution appends old instead of new when a match is found, leaving the string unchanged.
